validation_notes: Processed 18 people from TATN CSV: 1 CEO and 17 other TMT/board/management people. Checked 2 local documents in MOEXBMI_Отчеты_2024/TATN: the 101-page 2024 annual report and the 70-page 2024 IFRS report. Total research rounds: 18 person-rounds, one per person. Local annual report contains no detailed biographies for most directors, but confirms board structure, election date, corporate secretary, and executive-body structure; detailed biographies came from official Tatneft archived pages, e-disclosure/corporate-action documents, academic sources, and selected business profiles. Substantial uncertainty remains for 2 people: Neklyudov has no confirmed education in opened sources; Tikhturov and Mukhamadeev use weaker secondary sources for education/role details. Weak sources used: MarketScreener for Tikhturov and Global-Kazan for Mukhamadeev. Namesakes checked and rejected: Galiev search results were checked against Tatneft/government context; Neklyudov audit/advisory profiles were matched to independent-director audit expertise; post-2024 Khisamov death notices were not used to change 2024 status. No unresolved source conflict materially affects 2024 board membership. Search considered complete because local PDFs were checked, board membership was confirmed by AGM/annual-report sources, education and previous professional experience were separately searched, previous employers/academic institutions were checked where identified, and two additional passes produced no stronger opened sources for the remaining weak education gaps. QUALITY PASS ROUND 1 (2026-08-01): Step 0 git-baseline check found the on-disk file already matched git HEAD (commit f973022, the post-mass-restoration checkpoint) byte-for-byte apart from CRLF line endings -- no prior regression for this ticker, nothing needed restoring. Desync check (notes vs JSON) across all 18 people found no simple omissions and no genuine unresolved inconsistencies (every 'Contradictions' section in the round-1 notes already read 'None material'). GICS label correctness: only one professional_experience entry in the whole file carried a non-null GICS triple before this round (Гереч Ласло / MOL / G Petroconsulting Kft., filed as Industrials/Commercial & Professional Services/Professional Services) -- corrected to Energy/Energy/Oil, Gas & Consumable Fuels after re-fetching the official Tatneft board biography and confirming his MOL Oman role (2012-2016) was an internal MOL Group management position, not third-party consulting; MOL Group is a major integrated oil and gas company, the dominant classifiable entity in that combined entry. Verified (research, no change) that АО "Связьинвестнефтехим" (Сорокин, Глухова) is correctly non-classifiable -- confirmed via direct fetch as a pure Tatarstan state holding company with no operating business of its own. Honest-gap follow-up (bounded, one attempt per flagged gap): resolved/enriched Хисамов (professorship year 2005, monograph/patent breakdown -- h-index still not found, confirmed absent not unopened), Крюков (RAS academician year 2019, added RAS corresponding-member 2011, added a publications entry -- education year and h-index still not found; a promising cross-ticker lead in output/NVTK_person_info.json for his education could not be independently verified this session because the underlying novatek.ru PDF fetch returned unreadable binary content, so it was not copied in), Тахаутдинов (career chronology with precise 1965-2013 span from Wikipedia -- publications/h-index confirmed genuinely absent, not an unopened source), Неклюдов (education still not found after a targeted re-fetch -- but surfaced one new, previously-uncaptured employer, Группа БФКО "Открытие", Senior VP/Chief Auditor after its 2018 bank rescue). Attempted but found nothing new for Гайзатуллин (publications -- guessed Wikipedia URL 404'd, a Tatarstan government portal guess was unreachable), Тихтуров and Мухамадеев (both re-checked against the official Tatneft management-board archive page directly -- it lists no biography for either, confirming the existing weaker MarketScreener/Global-Kazan sourcing is still the best available, not an oversight). WebSearch was unavailable for fresh discovery queries this session (shared session budget already at 200/200 from other work); all fresh research this round was done via direct WebFetch of official/already-known-pattern URLs (Tatneft archive, ANTAT, SB RAS, Beterra, ru.wikipedia.org) with verbatim quotes drawn only from content actually fetched this session -- see research_notes/TATN/quality_pass_round1_20260801.md for full detail.
